title: Objek Tertinggal di Bibir Sungai
theme: Menjelajahi perasaan tak nyaman saat menemukan objek asing yang memicu perdebatan internal tentang kebenaran yang mungkin tersembunyi.

cover.prompt: An environmental shot of a tranquil riverbank at pre-dawn. An unoccupied professional DSLR camera is set firmly on a tripod by the water's edge on damp earth. The eastern horizon displays the first soft hues of a gentle sunrise, casting a warm and subtle illumination. A light, cool mist gracefully blankets the quiet water and distant trees, evoking a peaceful, contemplative atmosphere. Composition adheres to the rule of thirds, emphasizing the stillness of the moment.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, warm color grading, gentle ambient lighting

meta.plan_summary: A freelance photographer, Dion, seeking solace by a quiet river at dawn, discovers an anomalous old cloth doll. Its unusual placement and faded details, including faint initials, spark a deep internal debate between investigating the mystery and leaving it untouched. He ultimately decides to photograph it for personal reflection, accepting the unresolved nature of some mysteries, leaving him with a lingering sense of calm unease.
